about: What a host gives the UI (contract/resources.md): hostApi 1's operations (args as a JSON Schema subset: type, properties, required, additionalProperties, enum, pattern, maxLength, minimum, maximum, items, maxItems; the web's route and the shell's backend; the cap that gates it; an example for the contract tests), events, resource paths and the CSP. Hosts validate every call's args against it and answer an unknown op `unsupported`.
gesture: Ops marked gesture (habitat.run, bridge.correct, bridge.need, recent.clear, transfer.share, sortie.set) run on a shell only within 2 s of the person's key or click in the page: the page's last ui.input note, which the shell trusts only when its own evidence agrees (the panel frontmost with the web view focused when the note came, and the OS's last key or mouse input within 2 s of it); else `refused`. The site: bridge's Origin check and the session.

backendOp.about: Configured <backend>.<op>: fixed /v1 path (Habitat health: /healthz), GET or gesture-gated POST or PATCH, backend-prefixed scope. Web uses /api on its origin with its session. Habitat health/settings/setting use /api/house/health, /api/house/settings and /api/house/settings/{name}; setting posts {value}. Writes require same-origin and preserve caller audit context.

bridge.clusters.shell: unsupported (web session only for set-aside rows)

bridge.correct.result: {document, undo?} (document: bridge.doc's answer with edited, wrong, folds, types; undo: the correction's id, undoable for a short window) or, for reread, {document, preview}

bridge.usage.result: {series: Chart | null}: the usage series holding that document (bridge's utility bills; contract/chart.md *Chart*)

bridge.needs.result: {needs: [{id, source, title, detail?, since, action: {kind: url | op | command, label, url? | op? | command?}}]}: what only the owner can fix to keep the backend's data flowing (spaceport shared/backend/needs.md)

bridge.need.result: {ok, message}: a need's `op` action run by its backend

bridge.prefetch.shell: the speed layer, resource paths only

document.open.shell: download to temp, open (runnable files revealed); 404: the page

document.page.shell: the OS browser: url, else GET /v1/doc/<id>'s url, else <bridge>/doc/<id>

codes.list.web: GET /api/codes with owner session only; guests refused
codes.list.shell: owner device only: codes held in memory (Android, Mac, Windows)
codes.list.result: {codes: [{id, code, from, at}]}: the one-time codes beacon brought in the last 15 minutes (bridge's texts; `at` epoch ms when it came), newest first; never on disk or in a log

codes.copy.web: owner session only: that code alone onto the browser clipboard; expired or unknown: refused
codes.copy.shell: owner device only, native: that code alone onto the clipboard, kept out of clipboard history where supported (as clipboard.copy sensitive); one expired or unknown: refused

recent.list.result: {items: [{id, at, direction, kind: text|image|file, peers, preview?, link?, name?, size?, type?, path?, thumb?}]}, newest first; thumb true when /local/recent/<id>/thumb serves one

devices.targets.result: {targets: [name], enrolled?: [name]}: the send targets in the commands bar's order; enrolled, when given, those that can receive (another is dimmed and refused)

transfer.receive.result: {message, item?}: item the new Recent item's id (the UI selects it on an empty query)

drag.start.about: called in the row's dragstart (the mouse still down): recent its item (text, image or file), identifier and link their text, document its file (downloaded when dropped); answer when the drag session ends (the page gets no mouseup meanwhile and resets its pointer state then)

menu.popup.result: {id}: the item chosen (a model key the UI runs on that row), or {id: null}
menu.popup.about: a row's right click (Mac: control click): its keys, `key` a model key name (Mod+Enter) the shell draws as its menu's shortcut; `at` in the page's CSS pixels

window.preview.about: An allowlisted image resource, or null to hide. Returns true when displayed beside the palette, false when no room (the UI shows it above the list). No activation or input. Hidden with the palette.

window.resize.about: the window's size in CSS px: the panel's own (header, box, rows up to sizes.visibleRows, commands bar, status, hint) at sizes.width, whenever it changes; the viewer's frame (width 1040); the shell keeps it on screen, top-anchored

window.hide.about: the panel hides (the page has played its close motion); reason opened after document.open, document.page, map.open, url.open, recent.open or recent.reveal succeed (the opened thing shows); none after Esc, the header's close, a copy (after its ✓ Copied) and a hotkey's transfer shown for motion.flash

window.drag.shell: native: the OS moves the window with the mouse
window.drag.about: a primary press on the page's drag region (`[data-window-drag]`: the header, not its close): the window follows the mouse until the button is let go, then this answers; refused when the button is already up. The window keeps that place, top-anchored, until the shell quits (the next show on that screen opens there). No gesture of its own (the press's ui.input is the click's), never activating the app

window.popOut.web: unsupported (the site is a tab already)
window.popOut.about: the hotkey panel's pop out (its header's button, Mod+Shift+O): opens Deck's own window, or brings the open one forward: titled, resizable, minimisable, in the taskbar or Dock and Alt-Tab or ⌘-Tab, activating, open until closed (losing focus never hides it), its size and place remembered across starts; it loads app.html, its env.get's caps without `window`, and runs its own gesture gate. `state`: what the panel shows (the page's JSON, opaque to the shell: no secrets or tokens), which the window's page opens on: its first env.get answers it as `restore`; a page that has asked env.get already gets the `restore` event. Answered once it shows; the page then hides the panel (window.hide after its close motion)

glance.get.shell: the menu bar's last deck glance --json --worker <host> and its Sortie switch
glance.get.result: {glance: deck glance's JSON (tower, items, plans, worker, projects?, error?) | null (not answered), host: this machine's canonical worker name, sortie: {host, state: on | off | paused | drained | unreachable | unsupported, mode: off | auto | max, line, enabled, busy, pendingMode?: off | auto | max} | null (no switch on this host), updated: epoch ms of the last answer | null, hotkey: the palette's key (⌥Space) | null}
glance.get.about: the menu bar popover's page (glance.html) only: the popover host's cap; the palette's has none

glance.refresh.shell: deck glance read again, and the Sortie switch
glance.refresh.result: glance.get's answer, once both are read again

sortie.set.shell: this host's persisted Sortie mode: off stops new admissions, auto throttles for machine use, max bypasses activity and CPU/GPU throttling; memory, power and independent holds still apply
sortie.set.result: glance.get's sortie, read again after the flip; refused while it cannot flip (unreachable, unsupported, a flip on its way)

palette.show.shell: the palette shows (show reason tray) and the popover hides

prefs.get.about: the UI's keys: rail (the Related rail shown), details (the Details pane shown), recentCount (Recent's rows last time: the placeholders until it answers)

data.id: number: request id; page answers android.back after consuming one layer, handled false only at the empty landing

data.reason: hotkey | tray | link | menu | transfer (shown for a hotkey's transfer: its outcome follows) | share (a hotkey's share: the page asks its confirmation, as Mod+P) | files (Send to: files.pending follows)

data.act: action id (selects inside House, never runs; one not listed: the status says No house action <id>)
data.recent: a Recent item's id (deck://recent?id=: selected on the empty query)

data.item: a Recent item id, when received (selected on an empty query)
data.op: send | receive | share (its chip flashes on success)
data.busy: true while it runs (message: Sending to pixel…; no outcome yet)
data.hide: true: the panel was shown only for this; it hides after motion.flash when it went through and the person did nothing in it meanwhile

data.codes: owner web session or owner device only, on every host: the codes.list answer's list (optional: without it the page asks codes.list); never delivered without the codes cap

data.targets: the devices.targets answer's list (optional: without it the page asks devices.targets)

data.state: window.popOut's state: Deck's own window, open already, shows the panel's view (Deck's own window's page only)

glance.changed.data: glance.get's answer: deck glance answered again, or the Sortie switch changed (the popover's page only)

data.entity_id: the entity whose state changed (habitat.stream's patterns)

data.live: boolean: Habitat's stream open (true) or lost (false: the host reconnects)

android.ready.about: Android page back handler ready; deliver queued entry intents and Back

android.send.about: the Menu's Send file: the native device sheet, then the file picker

android.settings.about: the Menu's Settings: the native Settings screen

android.back.handled: boolean: page consumed Back; false lets Android leave

android.home.about: Shared page consumed Back; restore Find and its query and scroll, or load it for a direct entry

android.state.state: string: palette viewState snapshot retained in Android memory for return from shared pages

android.scroll.y: number: Find scroll position retained for return from shared pages

ui.input.at: epoch ms of the person's key or click in the page (every trusted keydown and pointerdown; never which key)
ui.input.about: the gesture gate's evidence (`gesture`): sent before the event's handlers run, so it precedes any op that key or click causes

ui.painted.sinceShowMs: number: since the last show event, else since the view (or the Enter that opened it)
ui.painted.frame: boolean: true after the next frame (the real time); false at 100 ms in a view with no frame yet (never shown, or late on screen), its frame's note following when it comes

selftest.done.results: [{op, expect: ok | refused | unsupported, got, pass}]: app.html?selftest calls every op once (reads with their example, anything else with args off its schema)
